import sys

def mex(s):
    g = 0
    while g in s:
        g += 1
    return g

def solve(data):
    # 允许 data 中元素个数不足: 缺失时按 0 处理, 并做界面回显
    a = int(data[0]) if len(data) > 0 else 0
    b = int(data[1]) if len(data) > 1 else 0

    N = max(a, b)
    # Grundy 值表: g[i][j] 为两堆 i, j 的 SG 值
    # 着法: (i2,j) i2<i ; (i,j2) j2<j ; (i-k, j-k) k>0
    size = N + 1
    g = [[0] * size for _ in range(size)]
    for i in range(size):
        for j in range(size):
            if i == 0 and j == 0:
                g[i][j] = 0
                continue
            s = set()
            for i2 in range(i):
                s.add(g[i2][j])
            for j2 in range(j):
                s.add(g[i][j2])
            k = 1
            while k <= i and k <= j:
                s.add(g[i - k][j - k])
                k += 1
            g[i][j] = mex(s)

    if g[a][b] == 0:
        return "LOSE"

    # 枚举必胜着法, 取字典序最小 (先 i 后 j)
    best = None
    # (i,j): 从第一堆取 i, 第二堆取 j, 不同时为零, 合法且落到必败态
    for i in range(a + 1):
        for j in range(b + 1):
            if i == 0 and j == 0:
                continue
            # 合法性: 要么只取一堆, 要么两堆取相同
            if i > 0 and j > 0 and i != j:
                continue
            if g[a - i][b - j] == 0:
                best = (i, j)
                break
        if best is not None:
            break

    return "WIN %d %d" % best

def selftest():
    # 逐例自测: 每例一行 PASS/FAIL, 结尾一行总判定
    cases = [
        # (输入 token 列表, 期望输出)
        (["1", "1"], "LOSE"),
        (["2", "2"], "WIN 1 1"),
        (["0", "0"], "LOSE"),
        (["1", "0"], "WIN 1 0"),
        (["0", "1"], "WIN 0 1"),
        (["3", "3"], "WIN 1 1"),
        (["5", "3"], "WIN 2 0"),
    ]
    all_ok = True
    for data, expect in cases:
        got = solve(data)
        ok = (got == expect)
        all_ok = all_ok and ok
        sys.stdout.write("%s %s %s %s\n" % (
            "PASS" if ok else "FAIL",
            data,
            got,
            expect,
        ))
    sys.stdout.write("TOTAL %s\n" % ("PASS" if all_ok else "FAIL"))
    return 0 if all_ok else 1

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "--selftest":
        return selftest()

    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    sys.stdout.write(solve(data) + "\n")
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
